name: Sui
install:
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  build-essential \
  ca-certificates \
  clang \
  cmake \
  curl \
  git \
  libclang-dev \
  libpq-dev \
  libssl-dev \
  pkg-config \
  g++ \
  postgresql \
  postgresql-client \
  protobuf-compiler

# The base image points cc/c++ at clang. RocksDB's C++ build then passes
# --target to clang and cannot find libstdc++ headers (<limits>, <memory>).
if update-alternatives --query cc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo update-alternatives --set cc /usr/bin/gcc
fi
if update-alternatives --query c++ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo update-alternatives --set c++ /usr/bin/g++
fi

# sui-pg-db and indexer tests spawn postgres, initdb, pg_ctl, and pg_isready
# by name. Ubuntu installs those binaries under /usr/lib/postgresql/*/bin.
pg_bin="$(ls -d /usr/lib/postgresql/*/bin | sort -V | tail -1)"
for bin in postgres initdb pg_ctl pg_isready psql createdb dropdb pg_dump; do
  if [[ -x "${pg_bin}/${bin}" ]]; then
    sudo ln -sfn "${pg_bin}/${bin}" "/usr/local/bin/${bin}"
  fi
done

rustup component add rustfmt clippy

if ! command -v cargo-nextest >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
  curl -LsSf https://get.nexte.st/latest/linux | tar zxf - -C "${tmp}"
  sudo install -m 0755 "${tmp}/cargo-nextest" /usr/local/bin/cargo-nextest
  rm -rf "${tmp}"
fi

# cargo simtest is a repo script, not a published crate.
sudo tee /usr/local/bin/cargo-simtest >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
source "${REPO_ROOT}/scripts/simtest/cargo-simtest"
EOF
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/cargo-simtest

cargo fetch --locked
